purpose: Coverage amendment: original 12 tasks constrain one wrist at one frame, not a trajectory. Keep domains separate.
metric_scope: Nine exact world-space wrist anchors; score only constrained frames. The path between anchors is not constrained. No physical reachability guarantee; failures remain in denominators.
sampling: Twelve geometries fixed before any trajectory result. Five paired noise seeds, randomized condition order per block. Separate 60-block trajectory estimand; not pooled with single-point tasks.
